top_signals.title: Samsung Biologics to Raise $2.2 Billion to Fund PolyPeptide Deal
top_signals.summary: Samsung Biologics Co. is seeking to raise about 3 trillion won ($2.2 billion) in a rights offering to fund its acquisition of PolyPeptide Group.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: DeepSeek looks for fresh capital as founder’s quant empire navigates China’s choppy IPO market
top_signals.summary: High-Flyer Quant, which bankrolled DeepSeek, has come to the fore, making a push into new listings as it chases returns in China's red-hot IPO market.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Canada poaches 48 top US-based academics
top_signals.summary: Trump administration’s assault on universities boosts Ottawa’s efforts to attract top research talent
